values.note: Forest Service-run, first come-first served; no reservation channel offered. Forest-wide stay limit: 16 accumulated days within any 30-day period.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cottonwood-campground (Reservations: 'First come-first served.'; Restrictions: 'Forest-wide stay limit: Camping in an area, campsite, or developed campground is limited to 16 accumulated days within any 30-day period.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cottonwood-campground ('10 camping units, a maximum recommended trailer length of 28''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: ADA vault toilet; no drinking water, no garbage service (pack it out), no cell coverage. Bear-resistant meat pole across the road. Overflow parking north and east of the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cottonwood-campground ('ADA vault toilet', 'There is no drinking water available.', 'There is no garbage service at this campground.', 'Bear resistant meat pole is available for use east, across the road'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually from late May to late November, weather dependent.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cottonwood-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open annually from late May to late November, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cottonwood-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $12 per night'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) rustic campground in the Gravelly Range, about 36 mi south of Alder via Ruby Reservoir Rd (from Sheridan, 8 mi south on Hwy 287 to Alder). Remote, no cell service. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms FCFS, 10 units, 28-ft recommended trailer max, vault toilet, no water, $12/night. Added the forest-wide 16-day stay limit and season (late May - late November, weather dependent, kept as a note). Not stated: hookups, pull-throughs. Note trimmed of the restated counts, length, toilet/water, FCFS and fee text.
